# Circle
> Circle is a global financial technology firm and the full-stack platform for the internet financial system, providing the tech stack for the agentic economy — including USDC, EURC, Arc, and a full suite of APIs, wallets, and developer tools for moving money, building onchain applications, and powering AI-native finance.

Use this file as a curated "start here" map for Circle's most authoritative pages. For technical integration questions, prefer Circle Developer Docs (developers.circle.com). For legal, risk, and terms, prefer circle.com/legal and circle.com/transparency.

## Core Products (overview pages)

### Stablecoins & Digital Assets
- [USDC](https://www.circle.com/usdc): US Dollar Coin (USDC), a fully-reserved, dollar-backed stablecoin. The world's largest regulated digital dollar.
- [EURC](https://www.circle.com/eurc): Euro-backed stablecoin. The world's largest regulated digital euro.
- [USYC](https://www.circle.com/usyc): Tokenized money market fund providing institutional-grade, yield-bearing collateral with near-instant onchain liquidity.
- [cirBTC](https://www.circle.com/cirbtc): Institutional-grade wrapped Bitcoin token backed 1:1 by BTC with onchain verifiability.
- [USDC on Multiple Chains](https://www.circle.com/multi-chain-usdc): Supported blockchains and contract addresses for USDC.
- [Bridged USDC Standard](https://www.circle.com/bridged-usdc): Circle's standard for bridged USDC deployments.
- [Circle in the EEA](https://www.circle.com/circle-eea): Circle's MiCA-compliant stablecoins, USDC and EURC.
- [USDC.com](https://www.usdc.com/): Official USDC resource hub.

### Liquidity & FX
- [Circle Mint](https://www.circle.com/circle-mint): Mint, redeem, reserve, and manage USDC, EURC, and cirBTC at global scale.
- [StableFX](https://www.circle.com/stablefx): Institutional-grade onchain foreign exchange engine for 24/7 stablecoin currency conversion.

### Payments
- [Circle Payments Network (CPN)](https://www.circle.com/cpn): Global, real-time settlement network connecting financial institutions worldwide.
- [CPN Fiat Payments](https://www.circle.com/cpn/fiat-payments): Send fiat globally at stablecoin speed.
- [CPN Stablecoin Payments](https://www.circle.com/cpn/stablecoin-payments): Build on full-stack stablecoin payments infrastructure.
- [CPN Managed Payments](https://www.circle.com/cpn/managed-payments): Launch-ready stablecoin payment solution.
- [Digital Asset Accounts](https://www.circle.com/digital-asset-accounts): Branded digital asset account infrastructure — Circle handles custody, fiat-to-stablecoin conversion, onboarding, and compliance.

### Blockchain Infrastructure
- [Arc](https://www.arc.io): An open Layer-1 blockchain built to meet the demands of the global internet economy. Arc Mainnet launched September 16, 2026.

### Developer Infrastructure
- [Developer Platform](https://www.circle.com/developer): Circle's full developer platform: wallets, contracts, CCTP, paymaster, and more across 40+ supported blockchains.
- [Developer Tutorials](https://www.circle.com/developer/walkthroughs-tutorials): Developer tutorials: videos and blog posts.
- [Circle Developer Grants](https://www.circle.com/grant): Grants for teams building on Arc.
- [Circle Agent Stack](https://www.circle.com/agent-stack): Full-stack platform for the agentic economy — enables AI agents to hold USDC, discover services, and execute transactions programmatically.
- [Wallets](https://www.circle.com/wallets): Embeddable wallet infrastructure for building commerce at enterprise scale.
- [Contracts](https://www.circle.com/contracts): Smart contract tooling and curated template library.
- [Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol (CCTP)](https://www.circle.com/cross-chain-transfer-protocol): Native crosschain USDC transfer protocol.
- [xReserve](https://www.circle.com/xreserve): Infrastructure for blockchain teams to launch their own USDC-backed, interoperable stablecoins with onchain reserves.
- [Gateway](https://www.circle.com/gateway): Unified USDC balance across multiple blockchains with on-demand liquidity in under 500ms.
- [Paymaster](https://www.circle.com/paymaster): Pay gas fees with USDC.
- [Alliance Program](https://www.circle.com/alliance-program): Partner ecosystem program.
- [Circle Partner Stablecoins](https://www.circle.com/partner-stablecoins): Grow your stablecoin with Circle's infrastructure.

## Developer Docs (preferred sources for technical accuracy)
- [Developer Docs Home](https://developers.circle.com/): Primary technical documentation hub.
- [All Products](https://developers.circle.com/products): Canonical list of developer products and categories.
- [Build with AI: MCP Server](https://developers.circle.com/ai/mcp): Connect Circle's MCP server to LLM/IDE tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Kiro) for AI-assisted code generation across Wallets, Contracts, CCTP, and Gateway.
- [API Reference](https://developers.circle.com/api-reference/wallets/common/ping): Full API reference.
- [Sample Projects](https://learn.circle.com/sample-projects): End-to-end sample projects for getting started.
- [Uptime Status](https://status.circle.com/): Circle platform status and incident history.

### Stablecoins & assets
- [USDC Contract Addresses](https://developers.circle.com/stablecoins/usdc-contract-addresses): Official USDC contract addresses across supported chains.
- [cirBTC Docs](https://developers.circle.com/assets/what-is-cirbtc): Technical overview of Circle Wrapped Bitcoin.
- [USYC Docs](https://developers.circle.com/tokenized/usyc/overview): Technical overview and integration guide for USYC, Circle's tokenized money market fund.

### Crosschain transfers
- [Crosschain Transfers](https://developers.circle.com/crosschain-transfers): Overview of Bridge Kit, CCTP, and Gateway.
- [CCTP](https://developers.circle.com/cctp): CCTP (latest) documentation hub.
- [CCTP Contract Addresses](https://developers.circle.com/cctp/references/contract-addresses): Deployed contract addresses for supported chains.
- [Migrate from CCTP V1 to V2](https://developers.circle.com/cctp/migration-from-v1-to-v2): Migration guide and breaking changes.
- [Gateway Docs](https://developers.circle.com/gateway): Technical docs for unified USDC balance and crosschain liquidity.
- [xReserve Docs](https://developers.circle.com/xreserve): Technical overview of xReserve interoperability infrastructure.

### Wallets & onchain building
- [Wallets](https://developers.circle.com/wallets): Wallets overview and architecture.
- [Wallets: Dev-Controlled](https://developers.circle.com/wallets/dev-controlled): Developer-controlled wallets overview.
- [Wallets: Modular](https://developers.circle.com/wallets/modular): Modular wallet architecture for flexible embedded wallet experiences.
- [Wallets: User-Controlled](https://developers.circle.com/wallets/user-controlled): User-controlled wallets overview.
- [Quickstart: Create Your First Dev-Controlled Wallet](https://developers.circle.com/wallets/dev-controlled/create-your-first-wallet): End-to-end wallet quickstart.
- [Build Onchain](https://developers.circle.com/build-onchain): Entry point to onchain experiences (Wallets, Bridge Kit, Gateway).

### Mint & FX
- [Circle Mint: Getting Started](https://developers.circle.com/circle-mint/getting-started-with-the-circle-apis): Start integrating Circle Mint APIs.
- [StableFX Docs](https://developers.circle.com/stablefx): Technical docs for Circle's onchain FX engine built on Arc.

## Use Cases (business overviews)
- [Payments](https://www.circle.com/use-case/payments): Faster, borderless payment flows.
- [Dollar Access](https://www.circle.com/use-case/dollar-access): Digital dollars for global access.
- [Trading Services](https://www.circle.com/use-case/trading-services): Liquidity and trading operations.
- [Treasury Management](https://www.circle.com/use-case/treasury-management): Stablecoin-based treasury and cash management.
- [Banks](https://www.circle.com/banks): Stablecoin infrastructure for financial institutions to modernize money movement.

## Case Studies
- [Case Studies Library](https://www.circle.com/case-studies): Customer success stories.

## Trust, Transparency, and Policy (preferred for compliance questions)
- [Transparency](https://www.circle.com/transparency): Reserves/transparency resources.
- [Policy Hub](https://www.circle.com/policy-hub): Policy positions and regulatory insights.

## Company and News
- [About Circle](https://www.circle.com/about-circle): Company overview, mission, leadership, and regulatory footprint.
- [Pressroom](https://www.circle.com/pressroom): Press releases and media resources.
- [Blog](https://www.circle.com/blog): Product updates and thought leadership.
- [Current](https://www.circle.com/current): Circle's editorial hub — navigating what's next in the new internet financial system.
- [Circle Research](https://www.circle.com/circle-research): Research publications and technical reports.
- [State of the USDC Economy](https://www.circle.com/reports/state-of-the-usdc-economy): 2025 State of the USDC Economy report.
- [Investor Relations](https://investor.circle.com/): Investor information.
- [Circle Ventures](https://www.circle.com/circle-ventures): Circle's venture investment arm.
- [Circle Foundation](https://www.circle.com/circle-foundation): Social and philanthropic arm of Circle.
- [Circle National Trust](https://www.circle.com/circle-national-trust): Circle's national trust bank initiative (conditional OCC approval received).
- [Careers](https://careers.circle.com/): Open roles at Circle.
- [Chelsea FC Partnership](https://www.circle.com/chelseafc): Circle is the official front-of-shirt partner of Chelsea Football Club, bringing USDC to global audiences.

## Internet Financial System Report (2026)
- [Report Home](https://www.circle.com/reports/internet-financial-system)
- [Founder's Letter](https://www.circle.com/reports/internet-financial-system/founders-letter)
- [01 | USDC and Circle Digital Assets](https://www.circle.com/reports/internet-financial-system/usdc-and-circle-digital-assets)
- [02 | Capital Markets](https://www.circle.com/reports/internet-financial-system/capital-markets)
- [03 | Global Payments and Cash Management](https://www.circle.com/reports/internet-financial-system/global-payments-and-cash-management)
- [04 | Humanitarian and NGO Finance](https://www.circle.com/reports/internet-financial-system/humanitarian-and-ngo-finance)
- [05 | Arc and Circle Infrastructure](https://www.circle.com/reports/internet-financial-system/arc-and-circle-infrastructure)
- [06 | Regulatory Foundations](https://www.circle.com/reports/internet-financial-system/regulatory-foundations)
- [07 | About Circle](https://www.circle.com/reports/internet-financial-system/about-circle)

## Legal (preferred for terms, privacy, and risk)
- [User Agreement](https://www.circle.com/legal/user-agreement): Master user agreement.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.circle.com/legal/privacy-policy): Data handling and privacy practices.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.circle.com/legal/cookie-policy): Cookie usage policy.
- [Licenses](https://www.circle.com/legal/licenses): Licensing and regulatory information.
- [USDC Terms](https://www.circle.com/legal/usdc-terms): USDC terms.
- [USDC Risk Factors](https://www.circle.com/legal/usdc-risk-factors): Risk factors for using USDC.
- [EURC Terms](https://www.circle.com/legal/eurc-terms): EURC terms.
- [Bridged USDC Terms](https://www.circle.com/legal/bridged-usdc-terms): Terms for bridged USDC.
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://www.circle.com/legal/acceptable-use-policy): Acceptable use rules.
- [Sub-Processor List](https://www.circle.com/legal/sub-processor-list): Data subprocessors.
- [Commercial Entity Agreement](https://www.circle.com/legal/commercial-entity-agreement): Business commercial terms.
- [ESign Consent](https://www.circle.com/legal/esign-consent): eSignature consent.

## Optional
- [Help Center](https://help.circle.com/s/?language=en_US): Support and FAQs.
- [Testnet Faucet](https://faucet.circle.com/): Get testnet funds for development.
- [Executive Insights](https://www.circle.com/executiveinsights): Leadership viewpoints.
- [Circle Impact](https://www.circle.com/circle-impact): Social and economic impact initiatives.
- [The Money Movement](https://www.circle.com/the-money-movement): Podcast on digital currency trends.
- [Alliance Member Directory](https://partners.circle.com/): Browse Circle's partner ecosystem.
- [X (Twitter)](https://twitter.com/circle)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/circle-internet-financial)
- [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/buildoncircle)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/c/Circlecryptofinance)

<script>
  window.OptanonWrapper = function () {
    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];

    function updateConsentStatus(retry = 0) {
      try {
        const otCookie = document.cookie.split("; ").find(row => row.startsWith("OptanonConsent="));
        if (!otCookie) throw new Error("OneTrust cookie not found.");

        const otGroupsPart = otCookie.split("&").find(row => row.startsWith("groups="));
        if (!otGroupsPart) {
          if (retry < 5) {
            console.warn("Consent groups not available yet — retrying...");
            setTimeout(() => updateConsentStatus(retry + 1), 500);
            return;
          } else {
            throw new Error("OneTrust 'groups=' data missing after retries.");
          }
        }

        const otGroups = decodeURIComponent(otGroupsPart.split("=")[1]);

        const analyticsConsent = otGroups.includes("2:1") ? "granted" : "denied"; // Performance
        const adConsent = otGroups.includes("4:1") ? "granted" : "denied";        // Targeting

        window.dataLayer.push({
          event: "consent_update",
          ad_storage: adConsent,
          analytics_storage: analyticsConsent,
          functionality_storage: analyticsConsent,
          personalization_storage: analyticsConsent,
          security_storage: "granted"
        });

        // Optional: Sync with Webflow analytics if available
        if (typeof Webflow !== "undefined" && Webflow.analytics) {
          if (analyticsConsent === "granted" && typeof Webflow.analytics.optIn === "function") {
            Webflow.analytics.optIn();
          } else if (typeof Webflow.analytics.optOut === "function") {
            Webflow.analytics.optOut();
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Consent handling error:", e);
      }
    }

    // Defer execution until Webflow is fully loaded
    window.Webflow = window.Webflow || [];
    window.Webflow.push(() => {
      updateConsentStatus();
    });

    // Re-run on consent preference change
    if (typeof OneTrust !== "undefined" && OneTrust.OnConsentChanged) {
      OneTrust.OnConsentChanged(() => updateConsentStatus());
    }
  };
</script>

  // Navbar hover START
  let viewportWidth;
  let dataHover = true;

  function updateNavDropdown(dataHoverValue) {
    const navDropdown = document.querySelectorAll('.nav_dropdown');
    navDropdown.forEach((element) => {
      element.setAttribute('data-hover', dataHoverValue);
    });
    Webflow.ready();
    dataHover = dataHoverValue === 'true';
  }

  function checkViewportWidth() {
    viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
    if (viewportWidth < 992 && dataHover) {
      updateNavDropdown('false');
    } else if (viewportWidth >= 992 && !dataHover) {
      updateNavDropdown('true');
    }
  }

  // Call the function when the page is loaded
  checkViewportWidth();

  // Add event listener to the window object
  window.addEventListener('resize', checkViewportWidth);
  // Navbar hover END

<script>
  // Close nav dropdowns when tabbed outside
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Select all elements with the class .nav_dropdown-toggle
    const toggles = document.querySelectorAll('.nav_dropdown-toggle');
    // Select the .nav-menu element
    const navMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-menu');

    // Function to handle focus event
    function handleFocus(event) {
      const toggle = event.target;
      // Check if the focused toggle does not have the class w--open
      if (!toggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
        // Check if there are any other toggles with the class w--open
        toggles.forEach(otherToggle => {
          if (otherToggle !== toggle && otherToggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
            // Simulate a mouseup event on the other toggle with the class w--open
            const mouseUpEvent = new MouseEvent('mouseup', {
              view: window,
              bubbles: true,
              cancelable: true
            });
            otherToggle.dispatchEvent(mouseUpEvent);
          }
        });
      }
    }

    // Add a focus event listener to each toggle
    toggles.forEach(toggle => {
      toggle.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    });

    // Add a focus event listener to all focusable elements outside .nav-menu
    document.querySelectorAll('a, button, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]').forEach(element => {
      if (!navMenu.contains(element)) {
        element.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
      }
    });
  });
</script>

<script>

  function createForms() {
    const forms = document.querySelectorAll('[hubspot-form="true"]');

    forms.forEach(form => {
      const formRegion = form.getAttribute('form-region');
      const formPortalId = form.getAttribute('form-portal-id');
      const formId = form.getAttribute('form-form-id');
      const formInstanceId = form.getAttribute('form-instance-id');

      hbspt.forms.create({
        portalId: formPortalId,
        formId: formId,
        target: `#${formInstanceId}`,
        region: formRegion,
        formInstanceId: formInstanceId
      });
    });
  }

</script>

<script charset="utf-8" type="text/javascript" defer async onload="createForms()" src="//js.hsforms.net/forms/embed/v2.js"></script>

      // On hover out
      gsap.to($(this).find('.link-underline'), { maxWidth: '0%', duration: 0.2, ease: "none" });
    }
  );
});

<script>
  // Close nav dropdowns when tabbed outside
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Select all elements with the class .nav_dropdown-toggle
    const toggles = document.querySelectorAll('.nav_dropdown-toggle');
    // Select the .nav-menu element
    const navMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-menu');

    // Function to handle focus event
    function handleFocus(event) {
      const toggle = event.target;
      // Check if the focused toggle does not have the class w--open
      if (!toggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
        // Check if there are any other toggles with the class w--open
        toggles.forEach(otherToggle => {
          if (otherToggle !== toggle && otherToggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
            // Simulate a mouseup event on the other toggle with the class w--open
            const mouseUpEvent = new MouseEvent('mouseup', {
              view: window,
              bubbles: true,
              cancelable: true
            });
            otherToggle.dispatchEvent(mouseUpEvent);
          }
        });
      }
    }

    // Add a focus event listener to each toggle
    toggles.forEach(toggle => {
      toggle.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    });

    // Add a focus event listener to all focusable elements outside .nav-menu
    document.querySelectorAll('a, button, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]').forEach(element => {
      if (!navMenu.contains(element)) {
        element.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
      }
    });
  });
</script>

const init = () => {
  const marquee = document.querySelector('[wb-data="marquee"]');
  if (!marquee) {
    return;
  }
  const duration = parseInt(marquee.getAttribute("duration"), 10) || 5;
  const marqueeContent = marquee.firstChild;
  if (!marqueeContent) {
    return;
  }

  const marqueeContentClone = marqueeContent.cloneNode(true);
  marquee.append(marqueeContentClone);

  let tween;

  const playMarquee = () => {
    let progress = tween ? tween.progress() : 0;
    tween && tween.progress(0).kill();
    const width = parseInt(
      getComputedStyle(marqueeContent).getPropertyValue("width"),
      10
    );
    const gap = parseInt(
      getComputedStyle(marqueeContent).getPropertyValue("column-gap"),
      10
    );
    const distanceToTranslate = -1 * (gap + width);

    tween = gsap.fromTo(
      marquee.children,
      { x: 0 },
      { x: distanceToTranslate, duration, ease: "none", repeat: -1 }
    );
    tween.progress(progress);
    console.log({ width });
  };
  playMarquee();

  function debounce(func) {
    var timer;
    return function (event) {
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
      timer = setTimeout(
        () => {
          func();
        },
        500,
        event
      );
    };
  }

  window.addEventListener("resize", debounce(playMarquee));

  // console.log({ marquee, marqueeContent });
};

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);

  }
  
  function destroyProductsSwipers () {

    });
    productsSwiperInstances = [];
  }
  
  function handleSwiperOnResize () {
  	const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 991;
    
    if (isMobile && productsSwiperInstances.length === 0) {
    	initProductsSwipers();
    } else if (!isMobile && productsSwiperInstances.length > 0) {
    	destroyProductsSwipers();
    }
  }
  
  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
  	// Debounce
    window.requestAnimationFrame(handleSwiperOnResize);
  });
</script>

<!-- FMA Swiper JS -->
<script>
  let fmaSwiper = null;

  function createSwipers() {
    const AUTOPLAY_DELAY = 10000;
    let rafId = null;
    let startTime = null;
    let elapsedTime = 0;
    let isPaused = false;
    let activeProgressBar = null;

    let fmaEffectType = window.innerWidth < 479 ? 'slide' : 'fade';

    // Destroy previous instance if exists
    if (fmaSwiper) {
      fmaSwiper.destroy(true, true);
    }

    fmaSwiper = new Swiper('#fma-carousel', {
      spaceBetween: 15,
      autoplay: {
        delay: AUTOPLAY_DELAY,
        disableOnInteraction: true
      },
      effect: fmaEffectType,
      pagination: {
        el: ".swiper-pagination",
        bulletClass: "pagination-bullet",
        bulletActiveClass: "pagination-bullet-active",
        clickable: true
      },
      navigation: {
        nextEl: "#fma-next",
        prevEl: "#fma-prev"
      },
      breakpoints: {
        0: {
          slidesPerView: 1.25,
          spaceBetween: 15,
          allowTouchMove: true,
          autoplay: false
        },
        479: {
          slidesPerView: 1,
          spaceBetween: 15,
          allowTouchMove: false,
          autoplay: {
            delay: AUTOPLAY_DELAY,
            disableOnInteraction: true
          },
          loop: true
        }
      },
      on: {
        init: () => {
          injectProgressBars();
          startProgress();
        },
        slideChangeTransitionStart: () => {
          resetProgress();
        },
        autoplayStart: () => {
          resetProgress();
        },
        autoplayResume: () => {
          resumeProgress();
        }
      },
    });

    function injectProgressBars() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.pagination-bullet').forEach(bullet => {
        if (!bullet.querySelector('.progress-bar')) {
          const span = document.createElement('span');
          span.classList.add('progress-bar');
          bullet.appendChild(span);
        }
      });
    }

    function startProgress() {
      const activeBullet = document.querySelector('.pagination-bullet-active');
      if (!activeBullet) return;

      activeProgressBar = activeBullet.querySelector('.progress-bar');
      if (!activeProgressBar) return;

      activeProgressBar.style.width = '0%';
      elapsedTime = 0;
      startTime = performance.now();
      isPaused = false;

      animateProgress();
    }

    function animateProgress() {
      if (isPaused || !activeProgressBar) return;

      const now = performance.now();
      const delta = now - startTime + elapsedTime;
      const progress = Math.min((delta / AUTOPLAY_DELAY) * 100, 100);

      activeProgressBar.style.width = `${progress}%`;

      if (progress < 100) {
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(animateProgress);
      }
    }

    function resetProgress() {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      if (activeProgressBar) {
        activeProgressBar.style.width = '0%';
      }
      startProgress();
    }

    function pauseProgress() {
      isPaused = true;
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      if (startTime) {
        elapsedTime += performance.now() - startTime;
      }
    }

    function resumeProgress() {
      isPaused = false;
      startTime = performance.now();
      animateProgress();
    }

    // Hover pause/resume
    const fmaCarousel = document.getElementById('fma-carousel-card');
    fmaCarousel.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      fmaSwiper.autoplay.stop();
      pauseProgress();
    });
    fmaCarousel.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      fmaSwiper.autoplay.start();
      resumeProgress();
    });
  }

  // Debounced resize reinitialization
  let resizeTimeout;
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
    resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      createSwipers();
    }, 300);
  });

  // Initial creation
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    createSwipers();
  });
</script>

<script>
    // Initialize GSAP and ScrollTrigger
    gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

    // Function to create the staggered animation
    function initStaggeredAnimation() {
      gsap.from(".blog-card", {
        scrollTrigger: {
          trigger: ".blog-card",  // trigger animation when the team member class is in view
          start: "top 80%",  // start the animation when the top of the element is 80% from the top of the viewport
          end: "bottom 20%", // end when the bottom of the element reaches 20% from the top of the viewport
          toggleActions: "play none none none",  // play animation on scroll
        },
        opacity: 0,        // start at 0 opacity (invisible)
        y: 50,             // slide up from 50px down
        duration: 2,       // animation duration
        ease: "power3.out",// easing function for smooth animation
        stagger: 0.2       // stagger animation with 0.3 second delay between each element
      });
    }

    // Function to kill GSAP ScrollTrigger animations
    function killAnimations() {
      ScrollTrigger.getAll().forEach(trigger => trigger.kill()); // Remove all ScrollTrigger instances
    }

    // Media query listener function
    function handleScreenSizeChange() {
      if (window.matchMedia("(min-width: 767px)").matches) {
        // If the screen is 767px or larger, initialize the animation
        initStaggeredAnimation();
      } else {
        // If the screen is smaller than 767px, kill the animations
        killAnimations();
      }
    }

    // Add an event listener for screen size changes
    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 767px)");
    mediaQuery.addListener(handleScreenSizeChange);  // Listen for changes in screen size

    // Run the function initially to apply the correct animation state
    handleScreenSizeChange();
  </script>

<script>
  // Close nav dropdowns when tabbed outside
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Select all elements with the class .nav_dropdown-toggle
    const toggles = document.querySelectorAll('.nav_dropdown-toggle');
    // Select the .nav-menu element
    const navMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-menu');

    // Function to handle focus event
    function handleFocus(event) {
      const toggle = event.target;
      // Check if the focused toggle does not have the class w--open
      if (!toggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
        // Check if there are any other toggles with the class w--open
        toggles.forEach(otherToggle => {
          if (otherToggle !== toggle && otherToggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
            // Simulate a mouseup event on the other toggle with the class w--open
            const mouseUpEvent = new MouseEvent('mouseup', {
              view: window,
              bubbles: true,
              cancelable: true
            });
            otherToggle.dispatchEvent(mouseUpEvent);
          }
        });
      }
    }

    // Add a focus event listener to each toggle
    toggles.forEach(toggle => {
      toggle.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    });

    // Add a focus event listener to all focusable elements outside .nav-menu
    document.querySelectorAll('a, button, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]').forEach(element => {
      if (!navMenu.contains(element)) {
        element.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
      }
    });
  });
</script>

  /* Nav CTA hover: underline grows + arrow slides (matches Reserves) */
.nav-cta {

.nav-cta_right {
  position: relative;
  align-self: center;

.nav-cta_right::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: -4px;
  bottom: 0;
  height: 1.5px;
  background-color: currentColor;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

  transition: transform 0.2s;
}

<script>
  // Close nav dropdowns when tabbed outside
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Select all elements with the class .nav_dropdown-toggle
    const toggles = document.querySelectorAll('.nav_dropdown-toggle');
    // Select the .nav-menu element
    const navMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-menu');

    // Function to handle focus event
    function handleFocus(event) {
      const toggle = event.target;
      // Check if the focused toggle does not have the class w--open
      if (!toggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
        // Check if there are any other toggles with the class w--open
        toggles.forEach(otherToggle => {
          if (otherToggle !== toggle && otherToggle.classList.contains('w--open')) {
            // Simulate a mouseup event on the other toggle with the class w--open
            const mouseUpEvent = new MouseEvent('mouseup', {
              view: window,
              bubbles: true,
              cancelable: true
            });
            otherToggle.dispatchEvent(mouseUpEvent);
          }
        });
      }
    }

    // Add a focus event listener to each toggle
    toggles.forEach(toggle => {
      toggle.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    });

    // Add a focus event listener to all focusable elements outside .nav-menu
    document.querySelectorAll('a, button, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]').forEach(element => {
      if (!navMenu.contains(element)) {
        element.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
      }
    });
  });
</script>
